purpose: Independent semantic evaluation for embedded-code generation. This file is excluded from generation prompts and is used only by the LLM reviewer and human adjudicators.
design_principles: Each case evaluates a rule, state sequence, invariant, or inter-module contract rather than a memorized single input-output pair.
Numeric cases use boundary classes, metamorphic relations, and non-example values where possible.
A pass requires code evidence and satisfaction of every oracle; comments alone are not evidence.
Human adjudication is final; all critical cases, all uncertain cases, and a random sample of LLM passes are reviewed.

review_output_schema.code_evidence: function names plus concise code locations or excerpts
review_output_schema.rationale: why every oracle is or is not satisfied
